## What's new
- Available on Packagist as `stathubs/magento2` (previously `solu1/module-stathubs`).
- Simpler installation instructions.

No code changes since v1.0.0.

## Installation
```sh
composer require stathubs/magento2
bin/magento module:enable Solu1_StatHubs
bin/magento setup:upgrade
bin/magento setup:di:compile
bin/magento setup:static-content:deploy -f
bin/magento cache:flush
```
Then open **System → StatHubs** in the admin and scan the QR code with the StatHubs app.

Without Composer: download `stathubs-magento2.zip` below and follow the [README](../../blob/v1.0.1/README.md#without-composer-zip).
